destinations.name: Loveland Ski Area
destinations.note: Partner mountain, on the top-tier Power Pass only. OpenSkiMap splits it into Loveland Basin and Loveland Valley. Loveland's own pages say the ski area is made up of those two base areas and sell an all-mountain ticket next to a Valley-only one, but no page fetched says which ticket a Power Pass free day is, so the Valley id rests on inference. The Basin id is safe.

destinations.name: Hesperus
destinations.note: Not on the 2026/27 roster as far as the pass site shows: absent from the 2026/27 Power Pass access list and from the site's resort list. The only pass-site page that names it is a stale 2023/2024 page still in the sitemap. MCP's own site still lists Hesperus as one of its ski areas, and secondary reports say the hill has not run since 2023. Kept so it is not silently dropped; do not show it as covered.
